name: Wizard OS 0.2.0
about: One Wizard OS version: the commit of every component repo, the images those commits produced, and the default app in each parking spot. Check with: python3 tools/check_release.py releases/0.2.0.json

modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

wizard-app-manager.note: Alongside mode is wizard-app-manager PR #12 (on top of PR #9, arm64). Both await Miguel; this pin moves to main when they merge.

wizard-os.note: specs + the generic `wizard` CLI (link / unlink / doctor); byte-identical copy vendored at wizard-app-manager/wizard-cli/wizard. A release file cannot name the commit that adds it, so this pins the commit before it.

wizard-app-manager.note: arm64 arrives with PR #9; on Apple Silicon VMs it runs under Rosetta until then

shell.note: index still lists 0.1.0 until the app index re-reads wizard-agent-service main

agent-service.note: index still lists 0.1.0 until the app index re-reads wizard-agent-service main
